All 4 chips (/p/, /ɑɹ/, /t/, /i/) show ✓ at 100%, and needs_work=[]. NETWORK: FormData audio part filename='take.webm', blob type 'audio/webm;codecs=opus' (11.9 KB, not a wav). critical_code_review_comments: api.js assessPronunciation: the filename is picked by blob.type ('audio/webm;codecs=opus' → take.webm, mp4 → take.mp4, else take.wav). This is correct, and the backend's ffmpeg normalises the audio to 16 kHz mono.
Untrimmed takes include leading and trailing silence, plus any noise before speech. Azure and the ear handled this fine in the fake-mic runs. Real-mic noise was not tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fake mic: add_init_script(fake_mic_init.js), then set window.__fakeB64 to the base64 of /tmp/{hannah,lily}_party.wav (/tmp/*.b64, made with ffmpeg -ar 48000 -ac 1). Playwright's post_data_buffer does not capture blob multipart bodies. Instead, wrap FormData.prototype.append in an init script to log the filename and type. Admin dictionary tab: admin-nav-dictionary.
